payload.title: sessions listing bugs from first real-data CLI run
payload.description: Five bugs found running the merged CLI (PR #1, origin/develop 9fc6584) against Ryan's real ~/.claude data (63 transcripts, read-only). sources, doctor and show work correctly on real data; every bug below is in the sessions listing path (or its interaction with it). Fixes target develop via feature branch; each bug carries repro, expected behavior, suspected code location, and acceptance criteria with a synthetic-fixture regression test (never Ryan's real transcripts).
